text:
Maya (Docs): Hey team — opened PR with airgap bootstrap samples, a suggested systemd unit for the hsm-agent, and a short UX note for the installer CLI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3210. Can ppl skim for link/var names and network notes?

Ravi (Infra): On it. Quick catch: installer example uses KMS_ENDPOINT but the SDK snippet uses KMS_URL. Should standardize to KMS_ENDPOINT. Also the NAT example references 10.0.0.0/8, we should use 10.128.0.0/9 for our VPC examples.

Elin (Eng): +1 on KMS var. Also note: HSM PKCS11 path differs between rpm and deb. I added comments in the PR to show both: /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so vs /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pkcs11/opensc-pkcs11.so.

Sam (Installer): pushed a change to the bootstrap script to honor HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY for offline bundle downloads from internal mirror. Snippet:
```bash
# download bundle behind proxy
export http_proxy=${HTTP_PROXY:-}
curl -x "$http_proxy" -o /tmp/redwood-bundle.tar.gz "$MIRROR_URL/bundle.tar.gz"
```
I added a note about checksum verification (sha256).

Maya (Docs): Nice. deploy-bot just flagged a broken link in the new network matrix. deploy-bot: linkcheck failed — /docs/private/networking#egress -> 404. I updated the anchor in the doc but need someone to regenerate TOC. :warning:

Elin (Eng): I can regenerate the TOC, but we should avoid fragile anchors. Maybe use explicit h2 headings and /docs/private/networking#egress-proxy instead.

Ravi (Infra): Also we need a short migration note for customers moving from onprem 0.9 -> 1.2 where KMS config moved from config.yaml -> env. Suggest a 1-paragraph blurb in the 'upgrade' section documenting the map (config.kms.endpoint -> KMS_ENDPOINT, config.kms.token -> KMS_AUTH_TOKEN).

Docs QA: Can someone add a tiny failure-case example for HSM slot busy? customers hit 'CKR_DEVICE_ERROR' during init; a suggested retry loop and systemd restart command would be helpful.

Maya (Docs): I'll add the migration blurb and the HSM retry snippet. @Sam can you add the systemd unit example to the PR (with Restart=on-failure and RestartSec=5)? :wave:

Sam (Installer): Done — pushed systemd unit w/ RestartSec and ExecStartPre that checks /etc/redwood/hsm.conf exists. Also added note about SELinux label if installed on RHEL.

Ravi (Infra): LGTM. One more typo: 'ciphersuites' -> 'cipher suites' in the network security note.

Maya (Docs): Great — thanks everyone. Plan: merge after docs-bot linkcheck passes and @Elin regenerates TOC. Targeting merge tomorrow morning. I'll leave the PR in review and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
